Once the rep has been placed the Character must spend ten(10) seconds to arm the Trap during which time they must keep at least one hand on the Trap. Once activated anyone who steps or touches the Trap takes "20 Poison Body" damage. A Trap can be disarmed by striking it with a Break or Destroy effect or by its creator spending ten(10) seconds touching it in order to disarm it. Disarming a Trap does not trigger its effects. A disarmed Trap is considered Destroyed. A Character may have no more than one(1) Trap, of any type, placed at a time.

Title: Trickster's Insight [Expertise]*
Name: Trickster's Insight
Benefit: The Character gains one(1) additional Spell Slot of each level for every time this Skill is bought.

Title: Trophy Hunter [Background]*
Name: Trophy Hunter
Benefit: The Character gains an additional Rank in the Trophy Hunter Skill See Page 209 for information on this Skill.

Title: Two-Handed Axe [Weapon Proficiency]
Name: Two-Handed Axe
Benefit: The Character gains the ability to wield a Two-Handed Axe in combat. The Character may block attacks while holding the Weapon with one hand but cannot attack or use the weapon to deliver any Skill until they have both hands on the Weapon. For information of the requirements for the Physical Representations for this, and other Weapons, see Chapter 5: Equipment.

Title: Two-Handed Mace [Weapon Proficiency]
Name: Two-Handed Mace
Benefit: The Character gains the ability to wield a Two-Handed Mace in combat. The Character may block attacks while holding the Weapon with one hand but cannot attack or use the weapon to deliver any Skill until they have both hands on the Weapon. For information of the requirements for the Physical Representations for this, and other Weapons, see Chapter 5: Equipment.

Title: Two-Handed Mastery [Weapon Proficiency]
Name: Two-Handed Mastery
Benefit: The Character gains the ability to wield all Two-Handed Weapons in combat. At the time this Skill is bought, the Character may "sell back" any Skills which are included in its benefit. For information of the requirements for the Physical Representations for this, and other Weapons, see Chapter 5: Equipment.

Title: Two-Handed Sword [Weapon Proficiency]
Name: Two-Handed Sword
Benefit: The Character gains the ability to wield a Two-Handed Sword in combat. The Character may block attacks while holding the Weapon with one hand but cannot attack or use the weapon to deliver any Skill until they have both hands on the Weapon. For information of the requirements for the Physical Representations for this, and other Weapons, see Chapter 5: Equipment.

Title: Two Weapon Fighting [Weapon Proficiency]
Name: Two Weapon Fighting
Benefit: The Character gains the ability to wield any One-Handed Weapon, with which they are proficient, in their off-hand at the same time they wield a Weapon in their main hand. This Weapon's damage is increased by the main hand Character's Weapon Training by an amount equal to the Character's main hand Weapon Training minus four(4). While this means the minimum damage bonus is zero(0), the Character will still cause the Base Damage of the Weapon they are wielding in their off-hand. A Character with this Skill would need to have at least five(5) Ranks in Weapon Training before they will receive any bonus damage to their off-hand Weapon.

Title: Two Weapon Fighting, Greater [Weapon Proficiency]
Name: Two Weapon Fighting, Greater
Benefit: The Character's damage with their off-hand Weapon is increased to an amount equal to the Character's main hand Weapon Training minus two(2). While this means the minimum damage bonus is zero(0), the Character may still cause the Base Damage of the Weapon. A Character with this Skill would need to have at least three(3) Ranks in Weapon Training before they will receive any bonus damage to their off-hand Weapon.

Title: Two Weapon Fighting, Superior [Weapon Proficiency]
Name: Two Weapon Fighting, Superior
Benefit: The Character's damage with their off-hand Weapon is increased to an amount equal to the Character's main hand Weapon Training.

Title: Vanish [Heritage, Stealthy]
Name: Vanish
Benefit: Once per Reset, the Character may grant themselves a "Lesser Physical Aegis" effect. The Character must be in shadows or darkness to use this ability.

Title: Vital Strike [Fighting]*
Name: Vital Strike
Benefit: Once per Reset, for every time this Skill is bought, the Character may deliver an attack causing "20 Physical-Strike <Weapon Type>" damage.

Title: Vorpal Strike [Heritage, Strong]*
Name: Vorpal Strike
Benefit: Once per Reset, for every time this Skill is bought, the Character may grant themselves a "Physical Vorpal 5" effect.

Title: Weapon Chain [Fighting]
Name: Weapon Chain
Benefit: A Character with this Skill is Immune to the Fumble effect.

Title: Weapon Familiarity [Heritage, Martial]
Name: Weapon Familiarity
Benefit: A Character with this Skill gains Weapon Proficiency in a single One-Handed Weapon, or Archery Weapon of their choice.

Title: Weapon Prowess [Fighting]*
Name: Weapon Prowess
Benefit: Once per Reset, for every time this Skill is bought, the Character may grant themselves the effects of a Vorpal 5. This allows them to increase the Weapon Damage call of their next five(5) landed hits by five(5). The call for this ability is "Physical Vorpal 5" A Character may have a number of Weapon Prowess that does not exceed five(5) plus one(1) for each Weapon Training they possess.

Title: Weapon Mastery [Weapon Proficiency]
Name: Weapon Mastery
Benefit: The Character gains the ability to wield all Weapons in combat. When wielding a Two-Handed Weapon, the Character may block attacks while holding the Weapon with one hand but cannot attack or or use the weapon to deliver any Skill until they have both hands on the Two-Handed Weapon. At the time this Skill is bought, the Character may "sell back" any Skills which are included in its benefit. For information of the requirements for the Physical Representations for this, and other Weapons, see Chapter 5: Equipment.

Title: Weapon Training [Fighting]*
Name: Weapon Training
Benefit: Upon gaining this Skill choose a hand; left or right. The Character increases the Weapon Damage call of all Weapons they wield in the chosen hand by one(1) for every Rank they have in this Skill. There are two ways to purchase this skill. The first is to trade in a number of ranks of Weapon Prowess equal to their number of ranks in Weapon Training plus three(3). The Character does not receive any build back for the traded in Weapon Prowess ranks as this is built into the cost for the Skill. The second is to purchase the Skill outright at a cost which is increased each time the Character purchases another Rank. For example, the cost for 3 Ranks of Weapon Training for a Character with Priority A in Fighting is 42 (12 + 14 + 16).
